decision: historical-degree-label-conflict; current host identities retained separately from awarder
evidence: CentraleSupélec's full official history dates the merger of École Centrale Paris and Supélec to 1 January 2015. The imported reported doctorate is dated 1994 under the successor name, so that individual's actual 1994 issuer cannot be inferred. The current official doctorate page says Paris-Saclay campus doctorates since September 2015 are awarded by Université Paris-Saclay; Metz campus doctoral accreditation is separately described. CentraleSupélec is therefore a real current école/research host, not simply an exact awarder alias of Paris-Saclay, but this imported historical claim cannot establish an additional 1994 CentraleSupélec route.

sources.note: Full official history explicitly dates successor merger to 1 January 2015.
Full official doctoral-campus page: Paris-Saclay university awards degrees at its campus since September 2015; Metz accreditation and Rennes consortium listed separately.

limitations: No person-degree correction is made. The imported 1994 issuer requires historical primary evidence during the later individual verification stage.

Current doctorate page's broad engineering and mathematics school titles do not establish a named Operations/Management Science/Industrial Engineering doctorate; any separate current LGI-hosted qualifying route requires direct doctoral-programme linkage before public addition.
